notes: Topline: Aurora runs a 3,500-seat blended contact center focused on telecom support + billing disputes. They want automated post-call summaries to speed ticket TTR and surface coaching moments.
Primary ask: generate concise post-call summary (3 bullets), highlight QA flags (policy breaches, sentiment dip, escalation), and provide coaching snippets for manager review.
Call recordings: 90% inbound voice, recorded in G.711, stored in Azure blob. Need connector to pull raw recordings for POC (2 weeks, 5 agents).
Quality targets: summary precision > 85% against internal QA rubric; QA flag recall > 80%; typical call length 6-9 minutes; peak concurrency 1,200 calls/hr.
Latency/throughput: summaries returned within 20s after call end for 95th percentile; batch mode acceptable for overnight bulk processing (ticket backfill).
Cost sensitivity: mid — want hosted API for speed but evaluating Dedicated for predictable SLOs during seasonal spikes.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, key management (bring-your-own-key), EU data residency for subset of EU customers.
Integration targets: NICE ACD for call metadata + Zendesk for ticket creation; tool-calling requirement to create/update ticket fields via API when agent accepts summary.

Quotes/voice:
 - From Dir of CX: 'If summaries can cut review time in half and surface coachable moments, headcount savings justify license.'
 - From SecOps: 'Need proof of redaction and retention controls before EU rollout.'
POC asks: sample transcripts (10 calls), raw audio exports (G.711), QA rubric, list of policy terms to flag (PCI, PII, abusive language), test Zendesk sandbox credentials.
Risk notes: accuracy drop on low-SNR calls; need fallback policy (degraded summary + link to transcript) when model confidence < threshold.
Docs attached: security FAQ, sample QA rubric, integration diagram stub (Drive).
Sales rhythm: initial discovery 2025-11-10; demo 2026-02-15; security deep-dive 2026-02-27; pricing/ops meeting scheduled 2026-03-08.
Pricing sensitivity: willing to pilot at lower seat count; expected enterprise commitment if POC meets KPI in 30 days.
Internal notes: ask Applied ML to run quick validation on 200 anonymized calls for accent coverage; infra to provide transient VPC egress config for Azure blobs.
Coach highlights expected: customer emotion shifts, 'next steps' clarity, agent adherence to billing dispute script, escalation handling quality.
